description: AGSC-06-39: a writer that serves /graph.nq emits /query/ unless site.query_page is false. Two sub-cases over the minimal fixture, built with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH set and no git history, for the Cloudflare Pages profile. (1) default: /query/ exists, is listed in /sitemap.xml (AGSC-06-19), is linked from every generated page, its HTML is at most 100000 bytes (AGSC-06-21; the query engine and its licence text are page assets outside that budget), it requests nothing outside the node's origin, its policy contains the five directives of AGSC-06-17 and none of 'unsafe-eval', 'unsafe-inline' or a host source, with 'wasm-unsafe-eval' admitted in script-src of this route only, and it carries exactly one Content-Security-Policy. The page answers SELECT, ASK, CONSTRUCT and DESCRIBE, refuses an update and a SERVICE clause, offers the ten questions of the graph as examples, results as a table (and a graph picture for CONSTRUCT, DESCRIBE or three-column results), CSV and JSON downloads, a share link whose query is in the fragment, and a vocabulary explorer; it stores nothing (AGSC-06-05). (2) switched off: no /query/, no file under it, no link to it from any page, no entry in the sitemap. The facts are asserted as such, not as bytes: HTML is not byte-pinned (AGSC-04-24). Derived by hand from the rule.
